en: An old sepia-toned photograph mounted on a decorative card with blue floral border. The image shows a large multi‑generational group of people, men, women and children, posed in front of a building or house. Men wear suits, hats and mustaches; women wear long dresses; some older men have traditional caps. Under the photo, on the card, there is a handwritten inscription in a cursive script using the Cyrillic alphabet, including a date that appears to be 28 April 1909 and a place name that looks like Sarajevo.
